Pose Landmarker Lite, float16/1 (unmodified model bundle)
Authors: Valentin Bazarevsky, Ivan Grishchenko, Eduard Gabriel Bazavan, Google
Source: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/pose_landmarker/pose_landmarker_lite/float16/1/pose_landmarker_lite.task
Model card: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/Model%20Card%20BlazePose%20GHUM%203D.pdf
The model card identifies the Apache License, Version 2.0.
SHA-256: 59929e1d1ee95287735ddd833b19cf4ac46d29bc7afddbbf6753c459690d574a

JavaScript, WASM and model files are served from the application origin.
The test harness generates its own geometric video and landmark fixtures.
No captured human imagery is included in this repository.

Changes: selected line endpoints, exact HIP matching, RA wrapped to [0,360),
Serpens parts grouped with separate polylines, explicit Hoshimiru constellation IDs.
